title: Deterministic Personal Office context compiler and bounded host-agent kernel

implementationCommit.subject: feat(context): add deterministic Personal Office kernel
implementationCommit.scope: shared context contract, compiler, package verifier, metadata guard, Work Engine snapshot adapter, optional text-only host-agent seam with exact raw-request binding, tests and product contract

handoffCommitNote: This JSON and worklogs/personal-office-loop-05.md are the only files in the phase-2 handoff commit. Implementation bytes were committed and independently reviewed first.
contractCompliance: Uses LIVE_CONTEXT_PRECEDENCE and effectiveLiveDirectives read-only; it does not reparse Live.md or bypass consent, supersession or expiry.
Requires exact workspace and owner scope on every source, package, kernel input and snapshot.
Keeps the base safety prompt in system role and the exact raw current text request in user role; only one bounded delimited segment is appended.
Does not trim or Unicode-normalize the protected current request; its canonical JSON string literal is hash-bound and compared against the exact string sent in the provider payload.
Reconstructs the system segment from validated items and compares byte-for-byte, so recomputing the public hash cannot bless extra system text.
Enforces compiler-owned source, item, decision and byte ceilings in both compiler and verifier.
Rejects forbidden classifications, raw credentials and reserved delimiters in content and rendered metadata; SecretRef remains opaque and unrendered.
Treats contentHash as deterministic content-addressing and integrity evidence, never authenticity or origin proof.
Writes only deterministic metadata through the accepted Work Engine snapshot API; snapshot IDs bind workspace, owner, content and optional run.
Host context binding is text-only; a turn containing context plus any image fails closed before provider or network access.
Managed AgentService injection is deferred because the accepted tree has neither an authoritative managed safety message nor session workspace identity.

controls: Unknown fields, invalid roles, classifications, provenance shapes and scope mismatches fail closed.
Safety and current text-request content is hash-bound but excluded from the appended segment.
The protected current request is preserved exactly and hashed through its canonical JSON string literal; trailing whitespace, line-ending changes and NFC/NFD differences cannot share a binding.
Context plus any image is rejected before provider or network access until the complete multimodal user payload can be hashed canonically.
Canonical ordering uses deterministic UTF-16 lexical comparison rather than locale-sensitive collation.
Verifier checks item hashes, exact canonical segment bytes, hard ceilings and decision/budget consistency.
Only public_metadata and personal_graph classifications may render.
Credential-shaped content or rendered metadata is rejected; opaque SecretRef metadata is never rendered or resolved.
Snapshot IDs include optional runId and returned run, scope, hash, source, summary, ref and schema metadata must match exactly.
No managed-agent context seam remains without authoritative safety and workspace bindings.

managedAgentService.blockingFinding: Managed AgentService history has no authoritative safety-system message or accepted session workspace binding, so caller-supplied context would be unusable or cross-workspace unsafe.
managedAgentService.correction: Removed the AgentService production seam and test; documented managed injection as deferred to a future contract and exact lease.

multimodalBinding.blockingFinding: The host seam hash-bound only the text request while images also influence the provider payload, so a contextual multimodal turn was not completely bound.
multimodalBinding.correction: Made contextual turns text-only and added a regression proving context plus any image fails before fetch.

exactRawRequestBinding.blockingFinding: The compiler trimmed and NFC-normalized current_request before hashing while the host sent the raw message, allowing byte-distinct trailing whitespace or canonically equivalent Unicode to pass verification.
exactRawRequestBinding.correction: Preserved the exact raw protected request, hash-bound its canonical JSON string literal and added provider-boundary regressions for trailing whitespace and NFC/NFD mismatch.
exactRawRequestBinding.challengeExecution: The Socrates role checklist was completed in-process because the root thread had no free agent slot; orchestrator sequencing and builder ownership remained explicit.

socratesReview.finalEvidence: The corrected tree binds the exact host safety prompt and raw text request, rejects byte-distinct request aliases and contextual image turns before network access, reconstructs tamper-resistant segments, enforces hard ceilings and metadata guards, binds snapshot runs and retains zero AgentService diff.

residualRisks: No production caller currently supplies an authenticated owner plus explicit workspace and exact base prompt to the optional host seam; wiring remains intentionally deferred.
Managed AgentService context requires a future trusted safety prompt and session workspace identity contract.
Future callers must compile and verify the same untouched raw text string that is sent to the provider; trimming or Unicode normalization before either step is forbidden.
Multimodal context remains deferred until the complete user payload, including image semantics, can be hashed canonically; contextual host turns must reject every image until then.
The unkeyed content hash does not authenticate origin; a future cross-process or cross-trust boundary needs its own authorization and signature or equivalent trusted channel.
W0 should rerun full desktop tests/build and authoritative graph impact after integration onto the current tip.
